label: Keeping conflicts with a clean Saga
description: You would expect a dead Plan to be deleted: the Saga is current state and Git keeps history. But frozen reviews stay, and why we did not build something is hard to find in Git. Keeping abandoned Plans is a recommendation, not settled.
